text:
Sam: Heads-up 9 - opened PR to refresh the model catalog entry for zephyr-aurora v1.2. Goals: add quantized variant guidance, per-variant context limits, short migration notes, and new Ruby + curl SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4239
Ivy: nice. Can you also drop a short troubleshooting FAQ about mismatched option keys? Runtime expects `quantize_profile` (string) not a boolean flag.
Jorge: also add a tiny section on routing when a request exceeds a variant's max_context. Runtime falls back to a longseq-compatible variant when available; latency and token-cost can increase.
Sam: will do. Planning a small table: variants (name), max_context, recommended use (hosted/dedicated). Any preferred ordering?
Ivy: put stable fp16 first, then int8, then longseq. And call out the default served variant for hosted customers.
Jorge: bench numbers I can paste: 512 p50 fp16 26ms / int8 31ms; 2048 p50 fp16 66ms / int8 82ms; note: at 4096 many int8 requests hit the longseq route depending on batch shape. I'll upload CSV to the PR.
Docs Bot: Template lint: model-card template contains an outdated link (`/docs/legacy/compat`) that 404s. Recommend using `/docs/compatibility/matrix` and add a redirect entry.
Sam: added link fix and a short migration subsection: "To migrate: switch model name to `zephyr-aurora-v1.2-int8` and set `options.quantize_profile = 'int8'`."
Ivy: snippet ideas: Ruby (concise) and a minimal curl example for quick validation. Ruby:```ruby
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(ENV['RW_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model: 'zephyr-aurora-v1.2-int8', input: 'Summarize ...', options: { 'quantize_profile' => 'int8', 'max_tokens' => 128 })
puts resp.text
```
Curl:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"zephyr-aurora-v1.2-int8","input":"...","options":{"quantize_profile":"int8","max_tokens":128}}'
```
Jorge: looks good. Add a short quality note: small degradation for int8 past ~2k context on certain prompt types; link to regression tests.
Sam: added a "quality note (draft)" with pointer to tests and marked the bench table DRAFT until CSV lands. Also added a tiny changelog line: "Model card: zephyr-aurora v1.2 9 - int8 variant, per-variant limits, longseq routing."
Preview Bot: preview published for PR #4239: https://deploy-previews.internal.redwood/4239 (staging) :white_check_mark:
Ivy: one last nit: ensure the limits table shows int8: 4096, fp16: 8192, longseq: 16384 so customers see exact numbers.
Sam: updated table, reran linter, and pushed. Planning to merge after Jorge uploads the CSV and QA approves. Thanks! :thumbsup:
